The [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''species''' [[Instructor/Legends|training master]] [[Jaing]] belonged to possessed skulls that bore a striking resemblance to that of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mythosaur/Legends|mythosaur]].<ref name="Prototypes" /> 

[[File:JaingSkull.png|thumb|left|200px|The skull of Jaing's species served as the initial inspiration for the Mandalorian crest.]]
Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] had large horns that grew downwards out of the sides of their elongated heads and could live for thousands of years. The only known member of the species, Jaing, was a renowned [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] training master who fought in multiple Mandalorian conflicts over the millennia.<ref name="TCSWE" /> The Mandalorian clans who served under Jaing adopted a [[Mandalorian crest|crest]] that bore the skull of his species as a way to honor him. Due to the skull's close resemblance to the skull of a male mythosaur, the Mandalorians of later times would interpret the crest as a depiction of a mythosaur skull. While the Mandalorians would adopt the crest as the collective symbol of their people, all connections to the crest with Jaing and his species were forgotten.<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>
